user_invitations_first_access_user_pendi.name: user_invitations_first_access_user_pending_unique
user_invitations_first_access_user_pendi.where: "user_invitations"."purpose" = 'FIRST_ACCESS'::invite_purpose and "user_invitations"."consumed_at" is null and "user_invitations"."deleted_at" is null

user_invitations_membership_member_pendi.name: user_invitations_membership_member_pending_unique
user_invitations_membership_member_pendi.where: "user_invitations"."purpose" = 'MEMBERSHIP_ACCEPT'::invite_purpose and "user_invitations"."member_id" is not null and "user_invitations"."consumed_at" is null and "user_invitations"."deleted_at" is null

users_address_state_registration_adress_.name: users_address_state_registration_adress_type_active_unique
users_address_state_registration_adress_.where: "users_address"."deleted_at" is null and "users_address"."state_registration" is not null

sale_conversions_source_by_type.name: sale_conversions_source_by_type
sale_conversions_source_by_type.value:
(
        (
          "sale_conversions"."type_conversion" IN ('ORCAMENTO-VENDA', 'ORCAMENTO-ORDEM_SERVICO')
          AND "sale_conversions"."budget_sale_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "sale_conversions"."work_order_sale_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "sale_conversions"."type_conversion" = 'ORDEM_SERVICO-VENDA'
          AND "sale_conversions"."work_order_sale_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "sale_conversions"."budget_sale_id" IS NULL
        )
      )

stock_movements_transfer_requires_sector.name: stock_movements_transfer_requires_sectors
stock_movements_transfer_requires_sector.value: "stock_movements"."type" <> 'TRANSFERENCIA' OR ("stock_movements"."from_sector_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_sector_id" IS NOT NULL)

stock_movements_transfer_requires_locati.name: stock_movements_transfer_requires_locations
stock_movements_transfer_requires_locati.value: "stock_movements"."type" <> 'TRANSFERENCIA' OR ("stock_movements"."from_locations_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_locations_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."from_locations_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_locations_id")

stock_movements_transfer_requires_batche.name: stock_movements_transfer_requires_batches
stock_movements_transfer_requires_batche.value: "stock_movements"."type" <> 'TRANSFERENCIA' OR ("stock_movements"."from_stock_batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_stock_batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."from_stock_batch_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_stock_batch_id" AND "stock_movements"."from_stock_batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_stock_batch_id" IS NOT NULL)

stock_movements_transfer_requires_locati.name: stock_movements_transfer_requires_locations_and_batches
stock_movements_transfer_requires_locati.value: "stock_movements"."type" <> 'TRANSFERENCIA' OR ("stock_movements"."from_locations_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_locations_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."from_stock_batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_stock_batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."from_locations_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_locations_id" AND "stock_movements"."from_stock_batch_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_stock_batch_id" AND "stock_movements"."from_locations_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."to_locations_id" IS NOT NULL)

nfe_events_header_chk.name: nfe_events_header_chk

nfe_headers_compra_gov_chk.name: nfe_headers_compra_gov_chk

nfe_item_exports_ind_chk.name: nfe_item_exports_ind_chk

nfe_item_fuels_cide_chk.name: nfe_item_fuels_cide_chk

nfe_places_doc_chk.name: nfe_places_doc_chk
nfe_places_doc_chk.value: ("nfe_places"."cnpj" is not null and "nfe_places"."cpf" is null) or ("nfe_places"."cnpj" is null and "nfe_places"."cpf" is not null)
